integration_notes: No source or brain edits made. Exact proposed row replacements are review artifacts only.
The raw logs/JUnit are outside sahool-brain and have content hashes. Code-regression tests were rerun on53652e02; they are not live deployment acceptance.

brain_state_transition_guard also requires executable evidence outside the brain for open→fixed in a PR. A documentation-only status edit may be blocked. Do not invent trivial code/test changes merely to bypass that guard; package this real existing-test evidence under the repository-approved reconciliation workflow.

Initial attempts before the shared environment installation failed with No module named pytest; these were harness setup failures and are superseded by the two successful archived runs, not counted as product failures.
